title: Protocol to identify small molecules promoting rat and mouse cardiomyocyte proliferation based on the FUCCI and MADM reporters
protocol: Prepare 100 mL of high glucose DMEM containing 10% fetal bovine serum and 1% penicillin-streptomycin.
Turn on the constant temperature magnetic stirrer, set the speed to 180 rpm, and maintain at 37°C.
Transfer 15 mL pre-cooled HBSS without Ca2+ and Mg2+ into three sterile 100 mm dishes and place them on ice.
Sterilize P3 SD rats with 75% alcohol, mainly focusing on the chest area.
Decapitate pups using sterile straight scissors and open the chest along the sternum to remove the heart.
Collect hearts immediately after removal and transfer into a 100 mm dish containing pre-cooled HBSS without Ca2+ and Mg2+.
Transfer hearts to other dishes containing HBSS with curved tweezers to clean and prepare for enzymatic digestion.
Digest ventricles for 8–10 times, collecting supernatants from each digestion.
Centrifuge collected cells and seed cell suspension onto two dishes.
Add 5 mL filtered digestion solution to a sterile rotor in the 10 mL sterilized bottle.
Transfer collected hearts into the bottle.
Cut hearts into small pieces using straight scissors.
Digest ventricles under 180 rpm agitation at 37°C for 5 minutes.
Leave ventricle tissues to stand for one minute.
Discard supernatant and add a fresh 5-mL digestion solution.
Repeat steps of cutting heart tissue into smaller pieces with straight scissors before the second digestion.
After third digestion, transfer supernatants to a 15 mL tube containing 5 mL high-glucose DMEM with 10% FBS and 1% penicillin-streptomycin.
Pipette up and down 10 times using a 10 mL pipette to stop the digestion.
Place the 15 mL tube on ice.
Add 5 mL digestion solution to remaining cardiac tissue.
Digest at 180 rpm agitation at 37°C for 5 minutes.
Repeat steps with the remaining cardiac tissue until it is flocculent.
Centrifuge cells from all 15 mL tubes at 200 g for 5 min.
Discard supernatant carefully and re-suspend cell pellets in 20 mL high-glucose DMEM containing 10% FBS and 1% penicillin-streptomycin.
Pipette up and down using a 10 mL pipette to ensure a homogeneous solution of single cells.
Pass the cell suspension through a 100 μm cell strainer.
Seed onto two sterilized 100 mm plastic dishes to allow fibroblasts to adhere.
Incubate cells for 2 h at 37°C in a 5% CO2 humidified incubator.
Gently wash dishes with 10 mL high-glucose DMEM containing 10% FBS and 1% penicillin-streptomycin after culturing cardiac cells for 2 h.
Transfer supernatant to two 15 mL tubes.
Centrifuge at 200 g for 5 min at 25°C.
Re-suspend the pellets in 10 mL high-glucose DMEM containing 10% FBS and 1% penicillin-streptomycin.
Pass the cell suspensions through a 100 μm cell strainer.
Take 9 μL of cell suspension and add 1 μL of 0.4% trypan blue.
Pipette up and down to mix them thoroughly.
Stain for 3 minutes.
Load 10 μL of the mixture into the well of a cell-counting chamber.
Determine the total cell number and viability using a Countess II Automated Cell Counter.
Prepare culture medium containing high glucose DMEM, 20 μM cytosine arabinoside, and 5% horse serum.
Pipette up and down using a 10 mL pipette to ensure a homogeneous solution of single cells.
Seed the cell suspensions on 96-well plates at 15,000 cells per well.
Incubate at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Remove the medium from the 96-well plate.
Calculate the required amount of virus according to the formula provided.
Dilute pAdeno-Tnnt2-mAG-hGeminin adenovirus in high-glucose medium containing 1% FBS at an MOI of 100 for each well.
Add the diluted adenovirus to the wells immediately after removing the medium.
Mix the adenovirus thoroughly by pipetting up and down before adding it to the medium.
Place the adenovirus on ice immediately after taking out from storage.
Thaw compounds in a 384-well chemical library plate at room temperature.
Centrifuge the thawed compounds quickly with a centrifuge dedicated to these plates.
Prepare high-glucose DMEM with 1% penicillin-streptomycin and 0.5% FBS for negative control or 10% FBS as positive control.
Aspirate the culture medium after adenoviral infection for 24 h.
Add fresh culture medium containing 2 μM indicated small molecules immediately to cells.
Ensure plates are free of liquid before transferring compounds with ECHO 520.
Transfer compounds from 384-well plates to 96-well plates in a volume of 20 nL using ECHO 520.
Distribute 100 μL DMEM with 0.5% FBS and 1% penicillin-streptomycin to each well using Multidrop Combi.
Make final working concentration of 2 μM for each compound in the medium.
Add negative control (0.5% FBS with DMSO) to wells as indicated.
Add positive control (10% FBS with DMSO) to wells as shown.
Place 96-well plate into incubator immediately after adding controls and compounds.
Seal 384-well library plates with sealing film.
Roll seal to ensure proper adhesion.
Return sealed 384-well plates to -80°C refrigerator.
Aspirate the culture medium.
Stain nuclei with Hoechst 33342.
Capture images of FUCCI [mAG-hGeminin (1/110)]-positive green fluorescent NRVMs using the MD ImageXpress Micro XL Imaging System.
Acquire at least 9 images per well.
Analyze 3,000 cells per well.
Count the number of FUCCI-positive NRVMs.
Count the total number of NRVMs based on cell segmentation using MetaXpress software.
Calculate the percentage of FUCCI-positive NRVMs in each well.
Determine positive hits of small molecules based on at least 2-fold greater effects on induction of FUCCI-positive NRVMs than negative control.
Isolate and seed P3 NRVMs on 24-well plates at 50,000 cells per well.
Infect NRVMs with pAdeno-Tnnt2-mAG-hGeminin adenovirus at an MOI of 100 after 48 h.
Dissolve each candidate small molecule in DMSO at 10 mM.
Dilute these small molecules into high-glucose DMEM containing 0.5% FBS at concentrations of 0, 0.5, 1, 2, 5, or 10 μM.
Vortex small molecules before and after dilution into high-glucose DMEM containing 0.5% FBS.
Apply diluted small molecules to NRVMs for 24 h.
Gently shake the 24-well plates after adding small molecules to cardiomyocytes.
Sterilize P3 MADM-ML-11TG/GT mice with 75% alcohol, mainly focusing on the chest.
Euthanize P3 MADM-ML-11TG/GT neonatal mice following ethical guidelines.
Open the chest of pups along the sternum after euthanasia.
Transfer 10 ml pre-cooled HBSS without Ca2+ and Mg2+ into three sterile 100 mm dishes and place them on ice.
Prepare 10 ml filtered 0.25% trypsin with EDTA and add it to a sterilized bottle.
Place the bottle containing trypsin on ice.
Transfer P3 MADM-ML-11TG/GT neonatal mice and 75% alcohol in two separate boxes, keeping cadavers in a third box.
Isolate cardiomyocytes from neonatal mouse ventricles with overnight pre-digestion by trypsin.
Use curved scissors to collect the ventricles from each mouse heart.
Transfer hearts immediately into a 100 mm dish containing pre-cooled HBSS without Ca²⁺ and Mg²⁺.
Transfer hearts to the second dish to remove blood and other tissues using curved tweezers.
Transfer hearts to the third dish for further cleaning using curved tweezers.
Make an incision in each heart with straight scissors without completely cutting it apart.
Gently transfer hearts to a bottle containing 0.25% trypsin with EDTA.
Place the bottle in a 4°C refrigerator and leave overnight (12–16 h).
Prepare 60 ml of complete medium consisting of high glucose DMEM, 10% FBS, and 1% penicillin-streptomycin.
Prepare 30 mL digestion solution containing collagenase II (0.5 mg/mL) and BSA (5 mg/mL) in complete medium.
Filter the digestion solution with a 0.22 μm filter and place on ice.
Set the stir speed of the constant temperature magnetic stirrer to 90 rpm and the temperature to 37°C.
Add 10 mL complete medium to the bottle taken out from the refrigerator at 4°C.
Place the bottle in a water bath under 90 rpm agitation at 37°C for 5 min.
Discard the supernatant after 5 minutes of agitation.
Add 5 mL fresh digestion solution and digest the heart in the water bath under 90 rpm agitation at 37°C for 1 minute.
Discard the supernatant after 1 minute of digestion.
Add fresh 5 mL digestion solution and digest the heart in the water bath under 90 rpm agitation at 37°C for 5 minutes.
Transfer the supernatants into a 15 mL centrifuge tube on ice, avoiding tissue transfer.
Repeat steps until the tissue is flocculent (3-4 times).
Centrifuge all cells in the 15 mL tubes at 200 g for 5 min.
Discard the supernatants carefully after centrifugation.
Re-suspend the cell pellets in 20 mL complete medium by pipetting up and down.
Pass the cell suspensions through a 100 μm strainer.
Seed cell suspensions onto two sterilized 100 mm plastic dishes.
Incubate cells for 2 h at 37°C in a 5% CO2 humidified incubator.
Incubate cell suspension for 2 hours.
Harvest the cell suspension and gently wash the dishes with 10 mL complete medium.
Transfer the suspensions into two 15 mL tubes.
Centrifuge at 200 g for 5 minutes at room temperature (18°C–26°C).
Gently re-suspend the cell pellets in complete medium by pipetting.
Pass the cell suspension through a 100 μm strainer.
Count the cells as in steps 26 and 28.
Prepare high glucose DMEM containing 20 μM cytosine arabinoside, 10% FBS, and 1% penicillin-streptomycin.
Seed the cardiomyocyte on 96-well plates at 15,000 cells per well.
Incubate at 37°C, 5% CO2.
Prepare high glucose DMEM containing 1% FBS and 1% penicillin streptomycin after 48 hours in culture.
Dilute pAdeno-Tnnt2-Cre adenovirus at an MOI of 200 in the medium.
Follow infection protocol with steps 31–34.
Prepare preheated adequate DMEM containing 0.5% FBS and 1% penicillin-streptomycin after 24 hours of infection.
Dilute candidate compounds at the optimal concentration in the medium.
Add equivalent DMSO to the medium (0.5% FBS) as a negative control.
Gently remove the medium from the 96-well plate by pipetting.
Add negative control and candidate compound media to the plates.
Incubate for 72 hours.
Stain the nuclei with Hoechst 33342.
Capture images using MD ImageXpress Micro XL Imaging System.
Analyze the data using MD ImageXpress Micro XL Imaging System.
Calculate the percentage of single-color cardiomyocytes in each well.
